The food looks like cottage cheese, rice pudding, or something similar. I'll treat it as cottage cheese or a similar curd. A layer about 2-3 cm deep over an area of roughly 60 cm² gives a volume near 150 ml, so about 150 g.

At about 100 kcal per 100 g for cottage cheese, or roughly 130 kcal per 100 g for rice pudding, that comes to around 150-180 kcal. I'll use 160 kcal.
